summary: Iteration 41 testing complete - Real-Time Signal Feed, Strategy Persistence, Auto-Switch. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend widget tests passed. New features: 1) WebSocket signal feed at /api/signals/feed broadcasting signals, decisions, outcomes, routing events with Live badge on Dashboard. 2) MongoDB persistence for strategy tracker (save/load endpoints + auto-save on record-outcome + auto-load on startup). 3) Auto-switch logic in decision engine that boosts winning model weights. Dashboard now has 4 widgets: IQ-720 LIVE | DECISION ENGINE v2.0 | STRATEGY TRACKER (3-col grid), then LIVE SIGNAL FEED (full-width below).
